tasks.title: Validate arithmetic operations implementation
tasks.description:
Verify that all basic arithmetic operations are correctly implemented and tested:

1. Run the test suite: npm test
2. Verify tests pass for all acceptance criteria:
   - Addition: 5 + 3 = 8 (test exists at line 93-96)
   - Subtraction: 10 - 4 = 6 (test exists at line 110-113)
   - Multiplication: 6 × 7 = 42 (test exists at line 127-130)
   - Division: 15 ÷ 3 = 5 (test exists at line 144-147)
   - Division by zero displays Error (test exists at line 154-157)
3. Review src/components/Calculator.tsx to confirm implementation:
   - calculate() function handles all four operations (lines 46-60)
   - Division by zero returns 'Error' (line 55)
4. Confirm all acceptance criteria from PRD EUN-77 are satisfied
acceptance_criteria: Division by zero displays Error message
